data: What is the value of the blue line at round 3?

The blue line represents the "Percent task collect" metric. At round 3, the blue line intersects with the red line, which represents the "Average collect reward." The blue line appears to be decreasing in value as we move from round 1 to round 4. At round 3, the blue line is positioned slightly above the 45% mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the value of the blue line at round 3 is approximately 46%.
